parsed.scene_description: A modern, well-lit bookstore or library interior featuring towering wooden bookshelves filled with books. A central spiral bookshelf structure rises from the floor. People are seated at tables or standing, engaged in reading or conversation. Warm lighting illuminates the space, creating a cozy atmosphere.

objects.label: spiral bookshelf
objects.observation: A tall, cylindrical bookshelf with multiple circular shelves spiraling upward. It is illuminated by bright white lights around each shelf level. Books are arranged on its shelves. Located centrally, it stands out against the background wall of flat shelves.

objects.label: wooden bookshelves
objects.observation: Large, multi-tiered wooden shelves lining the walls, densely packed with books. The shelves have warm lighting underneath. They extend across the back wall, forming an architectural backdrop to the room.

objects.label: person wearing glasses
objects.observation: A young man with dark hair and glasses, wearing a white hoodie with a cartoon character. He stands on the right side of the frame, looking toward the camera. His left hand holds a small object, possibly a phone or remote.

objects.label: orange chairs
objects.observation: Several modern orange chairs with curved backs, arranged in a group near the center foreground. Some are occupied by people. Their smooth, rounded design contrasts with the wooden shelving behind them.

objects.label: people sitting at tables
objects.observation: Multiple individuals seated at tables, focused on reading or using devices. One person in a white coat sits at a high table under an arched alcove. Others are seated at lower tables near the spiral bookshelf.

objects.label: arched alcoves
objects.observation: Wooden-framed arched alcoves built into the wall, each housing a small desk or table. They provide private reading nooks. Lights are embedded above each alcove, illuminating the workspaces.

objects.label: ceiling lights
objects.observation: Circular, recessed ceiling lights providing ambient illumination. One large circular light fixture is centered above the main bookshelf area, casting a bright glow downward.
